title: Build a Kafka topic capacity envelope
description: Choose a workload, then tune partitions, brokers, replication, retention, and consumers. The model exposes which limit fails first and preserves the arithmetic behind every recommendation.

workloads.label: Checkout events
workloads.detail: Moderate records with strict per-order ordering and a three-day replay window.

workloads.label: Device telemetry
workloads.detail: Many small measurements; compression and partition spread dominate the ingress plan.

workloads.label: Database change data
